blocks.tamil_translation: even more. As he kept on reciting, the horse bolted yet more. Hazrat Usaid (RA) says” I became afraid that the horse might trample my son Yahya (who was nearby). So I went and stood beside the horse, and I saw something like a cloud above my head, and within it I saw some things shining like lamps. Then that cloud-like thing kept rising towards the sky, until at last it vanished from my sight. The next morning I came into the presence of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. I said, “O Messenger of Allah, last night while I was reciting the Qur'an, my horse suddenly began to bolt.” The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, “O Ibn Hudair! You should have kept on reciting!' I said, “I was reciting and the horse bolted.” The Prophet ﷺ said, “O Ibn Hudair! You should have kept on reciting.” I said, “I was reciting. It kept bolting' The Prophet ﷺ said, “O Ibn Hudair! You should have kept on reciting.” I said, “My son Yahya was right near the horse, and I feared that the horse might trample him, so I got up and went away. When I went there, I saw something like a cloud with things shining in it like lamps. Then that thing rose towards the sky and vanished from my very sight.” The Prophet ﷺ said, “They were angels; they had come to listen to your recitation. Had you recited until morning, the other people too would have seen them. Those angels would not have hidden themselves from them”.
